top_stories.title: Nationwide Student Protests in France
top_stories.summary: Tens of thousands of students and high schoolers have rallied across France in ongoing demonstrations regarding education conditions and youth concerns. The protests in cities such as Paris have seen significant turnouts, road blockades, and clashes with security forces.

top_stories.title: Spanish Monarchy Reasserts Sovereignty over Ceuta
top_stories.summary: King Felipe VI visited the Spanish enclave of Ceuta amid heightened diplomatic tensions and migration pressures involving Morocco. During the visit, the Spanish monarch emphasized that the territory's sovereignty and territorial integrity are entirely non-negotiable.
